query: SELECT DISTINCT cm.collection_id, m.inventory FROM collection_member cm JOIN product p ON p.org_id = cm.org_id AND p.id = cm.product_id JOIN mapping m ON m.org_id = cm.org_id AND m.product_id = cm.product_id WHERE cm.org_id = $1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.binding_state = 'bound' ORDER BY cm.collection_id, m.inventory
